metadata.name: investscape-app-ribbon
metadata.description: One-page app main ribbon and Development sub-ribbon with accessible, four-language panel selection.
features: Internal panel selection without route/history changes

properties.name: locale
properties.description: Shared language: en, fr-CA, zh-Hant or zh-Hans.

properties.name: activeModule
properties.description: Active internal panel: workspace, quick, full, portfolio, market-intel, research, library or community.

events.name: moduleChange
events.description: User chose a different internal panel; bind to a validated update-variable action, never navigation.

specifications: Root is fluid and wraps ribbons on narrow screens.
No authentication, data access or network requests.
Main app page host keeps inactive panels mounted to preserve module state.
